aboutMe.subtitle: Who I Am
aboutMe.title: About Me
aboutMe.introduction: Hi, I'm Kevin! I love coding because it allows me to create things from nothing, it's like turning ideas into reality. Technology never stops evolving, and that keeps me curious. What inspires me most is seeing my code actually work and make a difference, even in small ways. Every project teaches me something new and pushes me to improve.
aboutMe.locationText: I'm currently based in Meiningen, Germany, where I live with my family and three children. While relocation isn't possible for me, I'm fully open to remote opportunities and highly value teamwork and collaboration across distances.
aboutMe.mindsetText: I'm an open-minded developer who's always eager to explore new technologies and expand my skill set. The fast-paced nature of the IT world motivates me to stay curious, keep learning, and adapt quickly to emerging tools and frameworks.
aboutMe.problemSolvingText: My approach to problem-solving combines analytical thinking, creativity, and persistence. I see every challenge as a learning opportunity to refine my understanding and improve my efficiency. I enjoy collaborating with others to find elegant and scalable solutions that not only work but work beautifully.

skillSet.subtitle: Technologies
skillSet.title: Skill Set
skillSet.description: I am a full-stack developer specializing in modern web technologies, with a strong emphasis on clean, high-performance, and user-centered applications. On the front end, I have extensive experience working with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Angular, and I develop responsive, accessible, and maintainable user interfaces. On the backend, I rely on Python, Django, and the Django REST Framework to develop robust, scalable, and clearly structured APIs. I place great importance on clean architecture, traceable data flows, and efficient communication between the frontend and backend. I continuously learn new technologies, frameworks, and best practices to keep pace with rapid developments in the web and backend fields.Translated with DeepL.com (free version)
skillSet.contactPrompt: Feel free to contact me. I look forward to expanding on my previous knowledge.

items.comment: Kevin made a significant contribution to the success of our project thanks to his clear communication, extensive knowledge, and quick grasp of new concepts. He was also always willing to lend a hand whenever help was needed.
